title: Saudi pilots filmed orbs

tellings.quote: I think if what was it last week two pilots in Saudi Arabia are flying and and they saw some crazy orb action

plain: Two pilots flying over Saudi Arabia are said to have seen and filmed what Michels calls "crazy orb action," meaning glowing balls of light in the sky. Michels brings it up himself in October 2024 as something from the week before, without naming a source. He uses it as a sign that strange sightings were still coming in from around the world.
